items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022

ctx.x: These are some things you said about different players. “Harmon-muted” “Zottola- buzzing” “Corea fluttering lines,” talking about a singer, her approach to the lyrics is pristine and emotive and a tenor player who wails brazenly, energized entitles. All these things were part of your descriptive writing on different recordings. So my question is do you have literally perhaps, a page of adjectives? You know there’s that famous saying, “Writing about music is like dancing about architecture.” Right?
